paper_metadata.title: Ultra-high strain-rate strengthening in ductile refractory high entropy alloys upon dynamic loading

evidence.quote: The mechanical properties and strain-rate strengthening mechanism of single-phase TiZrHfNbTaMox (x ¼ 0.25, 0.5, and 0.75) refractory high entropy alloys (RHEAs) upon dynamic loading are investigated.
